description.soundtrack: Create a soundtrack and upload its first recording.
description.version: Add a different recording in languages not yet assigned to this soundtrack.
description.upload: Upload or replace the MP3 for this recording.
description.languages: Choose every language that should use this recording.

externalHint: Enter the track ID, not a Spotify URL. The server retrieves the title and artist.
languagesHint: The same recording can serve multiple languages. Each language belongs to one recording per soundtrack.
fileHint: Only a non-empty MP3 file is accepted. Upload starts when you submit.
invalidMp3: Choose a valid, non-empty .mp3 audio file.
createdCheckpoint: The recording has been created. Retry the upload here, or resume later from its card.
uploadedCheckpoint: Audio uploaded. Only server confirmation remains; the file will not be uploaded again.
uncertain: The server may have created the recording before the connection failed. Close this window and check the refreshed movie before creating another one.

errors.network: Connection failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.bad-request: Check the track ID, languages and audio file.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
errors.not-found: The track or upload endpoint is unavailable. Reload the movie; contact your administrator if the issue persists.
errors.conflict: The requested operation conflicts with current data. A language may already be assigned, or the audio may not be ready for confirmation.
errors.server: The server could not complete the operation. Please try again.
errors.unknown: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.

multipleFiles: Select one audio file at a time.
